metrics.leakage_safe_split_type: 15-minute block holdout (disjoint time windows, 0 adjacent-second leakage)

limitations: Trained strictly on Mendeley E-nose Beef Quality Dataset (doi:10.17632/n8mc3nspfn.1)
Single physical beef sample monitored over 28.9 hours — naive random split (99.78%) is inflated by 5-second autocorrelation leakage
Scientifically validated generalization performance is 93.10% accuracy / 0.8718 Macro-F1 under 15-minute block holdout
Scope is strictly BEEF QUALITY ONLY — not calibrated for poultry, pork, seafood, dairy, or fresh produce
Requires DHT11 (temp, humidity) and 8 MOS gas sensors (MQ2-MQ138) for inference
Human sensory inspection remains mandatory before food redistribution
